author: श्रीराघवेन्द्रस्वामी
commentary: किञ्च भूतेषु नानाविधप्राणिष्वविभक्तमेव विभक्तमिव स्थितम् । अज्ञानां तथा प्रतीतमिति यावत् । भूतभतृ भूतानां भर्तृ धारणपोषणकर्तृ तद्ब्रह्म ज्ञेयम् । ग्रसिष्णु प्रलये सर्वभक्षकम् । प्रभविष्णु सृष्टिकाले सर्वोत्पादकं च ॥ १३.१७॥
translation:
Undivided it is in all the separate beings as if it were a divisible thing; it is the support of beings, it is the swallower and the producer. It is to be known as (such). (17) 
V. As if it were, &c., to the ignorant Brahman seems divisible matter, not really divisible. The swallower: of everything during Pralaya or destruction of the world. The producer: the creator; the period for creation returning.
